plain: How much more often the judge says YES to real YES items than to real NO items; 0 means it ignores the item.
eli5: Do you say “yes” more to the good ones than to the bad ones? By how much?
technical: Youden (1950), Peirce skill score: sensitivity + specificity − 1 = TPR − FPR, the height of the ROC point above the chance diagonal. Prevalence-free; implicitly sets misses and false alarms equal per class.
